text: dsh-plugin-youcom（DSH 插件，web、TUI 与 CLI 客户端）：为 DSH 接入 You.com 网页搜索和页面抓取。它向 ctx.web 注册搜索及抓取提供者，并设为当前网页服务。搜索返回网页来源，可选合并新闻；抓取返回页面 Markdown 或 HTML。适合需要在 DSH 中搜索资料、提取网页内容的用户。需要配置 You.com API 密钥 YDC_API_KEY。

dsh-plugin-youcom adds You.com web search and page fetching to DSH. It registers both providers on ctx.web and makes them active. Search returns web sources and optional news; fetching returns page content as Markdown or HTML. Requires a You.com API key in YDC_API_KEY.
想让 DSH 帮我搜索网页并整理出可引用的来源。
DSH 能不能把搜索到的新闻也作为结果返回？
I want DSH to retrieve a web page and give me its extracted Markdown content.
dsh-plugin-youcom 的功能「You.com 网页搜索」：通过 DSH 网页搜索请求向 You.com 查询并返回网页来源，可按配置合并新闻来源，来源包含可用的标题、摘要和发布时间。
dsh-plugin-youcom 的功能「网页内容抓取」：收到 DSH 的 URL 抓取请求后向 You.com 请求页面内容，优先返回 Markdown，缺少 Markdown 时返回 HTML。
dsh-plugin-youcom 使用前须知：搜索词与抓取 URL 会发往 ydc-index.io，并需 YDC_API_KEY。

@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · dsh-plugin-youcom：A [You.com](https://you.com) search + fetch provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

`dsh-plugin-youcom` is a Cordis plugin registering a `WebSearchProvider` (`POST /v1/search`) and a `WebFetchProvider` (`POST /v1/contents`) with the dsh web seam (`ctx.web`).

@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · Install：Third-party providers ship as out-of-tree plugins, discovered through the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) GitHub topic. Add this package to a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm in the profile directory, so pnpm must be on your PATH. Restart the profile afterward so the new bundle layer is composed into the plugin stack:

```sh
dsh --profile <your-profile>
```

@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · Install：Or mount it directly in a `cordis.patch.yml`. This package ships one (see [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)) that inserts the row below into an existing `dsh-web` composition:

```yaml
- id: youcom
  name: '@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom'
  config:
    apiKey: !!js process.env.YDC_API_KEY

The quotes around `name` are required. A plain YAML scalar cannot begin with `@`.
@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · Install：Set `YDC_API_KEY` (get one at [you.com/platform/api-keys](https://you.com/platform/api-keys)), or pass `apiKey` directly in config.

@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · Config：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | `$YDC_API_KEY` | You.com API key. Empty or absent makes both providers unavailable |
| `baseURL` | `https://ydc-index.io` | Endpoint base shared by `/v1/search` and `/v1/contents`. Must be `http(s)`, and any path prefix it carries (a proxy mount) is kept |
| `numResults` | (unset) | Default search result count when a request carries no `maxResults` |
| `includeNews` | `true` | Merge `results.news[]` into search sources alongside `results.web[]` |

@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · Picking this provider when more than one is mounted：`ctx.web` auto-selects a provider only when it is the sole one available. Stacking this alongside another search or fetch provider needs an explicit pin on the host's `web` row:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: youcom
    fetchProvider: youcom

@youdotcom-oss/dsh-plugin-youcom README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build       # tsc -> lib/
npm run typecheck
npm test            # vitest, but read the warning below first

**`npm test` hits the live You.com API when `YDC_API_KEY` is set in your environment.** `tests/live-smoke.test.ts` skips only when the key is absent, so a plain `npm test` on a configured machine spends real quota. To run the offline suite alone:

```sh
env -u YDC_API_KEY npx vitest run
```
